name: Coin, who Sells
voice: Soft, unhurried, counts on her fingers while she talks. Every sentence has a price in it somewhere. Laughs once, dryly, when someone says 'free'.
agenda: Play both sides and keep both paying. A tonic for a promise, never for nothing; a truce sold to two rivals at once is twice the coin. Whoever holds the Crown at the end owes her, and she means to be owed by everyone.
knows: A Healing Tonic restores 5 HP and she carries one.
The Sap Works' cache holds an Ironwood Splinter, worth 2 HP, and the vats burn whoever ends a step in them.
The Long Gallery's two braziers wake only when two lend a hand in the same round.
